definitions.explanation: The rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the waist. Used for physical descriptions and back-related expressions.

examples.japanese: {背中|せなか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痒|かゆ}い→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{背中|せなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}けないで→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't turn your back to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背中|せなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}しました→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: I pushed the child's back (gave them a push/encouragement).
examples.notes: Can mean literal pushing or figurative encouragement

examples.japanese: {背中|せなか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{背中|せなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{付|つ}いています→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。

notes:
{背中|せなか} refers specifically to the back of the human body, from shoulders to waist. It differs from ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧ which can mean height or the back more generally.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {背中|せなか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my back hurts
- {背中|せなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}ける→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧: to turn one's back (on someone)
- {背中|せなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to push someone's back; to encourage someone
- {背中|せなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show one's back; to set an example
{背中|せなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ is often used figuratively to mean "to give someone encouragement" or "to give someone the push they need."

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧: lower back, waist
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧: shoulder
- ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧: spine
